entities.name: Bombyx mori prothoracicostatic peptide
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P82003 (100% identity and full query/target coverage; E-value 9.69e-70).
Annotated to inhibit ecdysteroid biosynthesis in the prothoracic gland of fifth-instar larvae; reported to delay commencement of spinning behavior when administered to day-8 fifth-instar larvae.
Annotated as secreted; GO:0005576 extracellular region and GO:0002168 instar larval development.
Sequence-derived properties: 274 aa, estimated mass 31,659.5 Da, theoretical pI 6.67, GRAVY −1.034; estimates do not account for processing or modifications.
Pfam scan returned no result; this does not establish absence of domains.
